# NOBU.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp561.0 against Rp376.0 (expected total return 49.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The cost of equity stated in s4 cannot be reproduced from its own components: 10y FR 7.4% + 0.90 x ERP 4.2% + CRP 2.5% = 13.68%, not the 11.9% quoted. The engine actually uses 11.85% (rf 7.45% - 1.62% Indonesia default s
- The thesis' central causal claim contradicts the cited source. S10 says the 0% MDR already applied to UMi (micro) merchants on tickets up to Rp500,000 - quote: 'kebijakan ini cuma berlaku pada usaha mikro (UMi)... nilai 
- No corporate-action scenario despite the report naming it as the trigger. s7 says 'a deep discount to book persists until a corporate action forces a repricing', s5 lists 'an OJK-approved strategic transaction with a str

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
